query:
SELECT s.twitch_user_id,
               i.discord_user_id,
               i.discord_display_name
          FROM twitch_streamers s
          LEFT JOIN twitch_streamer_identities i
            ON i.twitch_login <> ''
           AND LOWER(i.twitch_login) = LOWER(s.twitch_login)
         WHERE LOWER(s.twitch_login) = LOWER($1)
